audit.doubleCreditPrevention: Every promotional claim executes inside withTransaction with FOR UPDATE row locks
audit.missingDebitPrevention: When placing bets, stake is atomically deducted in allocateCashStake according to fund hierarchy
audit.freebetDoubleSpendPrevention: Protected by atomic balance checks and row-level locking
audit.negativeBalancePrevention: Wallets table balance constraints enforce non-negative balances
audit.orphanLedgerEntryPrevention: Wallet updates and ledger inserts are committed in the same database transaction
